name: Planning Commission Special Meeting
agenda_text:
NOTICE AND CALL OF A SPECIAL MEETING
OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF AZUSA
TO THE MEMBERS OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF AZUSA:
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN, that a Special Meeting of the Planning Commission is hereby called to be held on WEDNESDAY, MAY 31, 2023 at 7:00 p.m. at the Azusa Auditorium, located at 213 E. Foothill Blvd, Azusa, California 91702.
Said Special Meeting shall be for discussing, hearing and taking action on the items listed below:
AGENDA
NOTICE TO THE PUBLIC FOR REGULAR MEETING.
A)
CALL TO ORDER
B)
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
C)
ROLL CALL
D)
MINUTES
E)
PUBLIC PARTICIPATION - (Person/Group shall be allowed to speak without interruption up to five (5) minutes in compliance with applicable meeting rules. Questions to the speaker or response to questions or comments shall be handled after the speaker has completed his/her comments).
F)
PUBLIC HEARING
1.
Azusa Housing for All - The Planning Commission will consider adopting a resolution making a recommendation to the City Council regarding amendments made to the adopted Housing Element. The 6th Cycle (2021-2029) of the City of Azusa Housing Element (Housing for All) was adopted by the Azusa City Council on March 7, 2022. In response to comments received from the HCD during their review of the adopted document, additional analysis and clarification were provided including specific metrics and objectives to accomplish housing policy set forth in adopted Housing element. Additional analysis regarding: 1. housing needs of specials needs groups, 2. Factors contributing to fair housing, and 3. non-vacant sites used to meet city?s RHNA numbers were also provided.
F-1 - Housing Element Amendments (1)
G)

H)

I)

J)
